title: Sketch ($5)
description: A clean digital lineart sketch of your character. Includes solid background color. Perfect for quick concepts or profile icons. No complex rendering or shading included.

title: Full Drawing ($30)
description: Completely polished illustration. Includes full clean lineart, cell-shading, detailed lighting effects, and transparent or simple geometric background elements.

title: Model Commission ($60)
description: Art ready for rigging. High-resolution full body illustration separated into distinct layers (eyes, hair tufts, limbs, torso) organized in a PSD file. Designed specifically for VTuber or animation use.
